# Aitor Alonso (https://aalonso.dev/)

> I'm a product-minded senior software engineer that turns complex problems into elegant solutions. Experienced in backend, frontend, and mobile development, my expertise is in Elixir, Golang, and Node.js.

## About author

Aitor Alonso is a product-minded senior software engineer with more than 10 years of experience in software development. He specializes in backend, frontend, and mobile development, with particular expertise in Elixir, Golang, and Node.js with TypeScript. 

He believes in the perfect balance between technical excellence and business value, combining experience in Domain Driven Design (DDD) and Clean Architectures to build systems that are not only technically sound but also align perfectly with business objectives. He's passionate about building scalable, user-centric applications and focuses on delivering practical solutions that solve real problems without unnecessary complexity.

Currently working as a Senior Software Engineer at Cabify, remotely in Madrid, Spain. He's been involved in the full software development life cycle, from architectural design and solution devising to implementation, continuous integration, deployment and delivery.
